description: This file defines a PHP class Smarty_Template_Compiled that handles compilation, rendering, and management of Smarty template files within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for loading, processing, compiling, and rendering template source files, as well as managing compiled PHP template files.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Compiled
classes.description: Class responsible for managing compiled Smarty templates, including loading, rendering, processing, compiling source templates into PHP, and handling cache invalidation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns a compiled object of the source template, populating its filepath.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the filepath attribute for the compiled template based on source template properties and Smarty configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the compiled template, with debugging support, and manages cache and uncompiled rendering as needed.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the source template, compiling it if necessary, and loads the compiled version.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Compiles the source template into PHP code and writes it to the filepath.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes compiled PHP code to the filesystem using the handler's writeFile method.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the compiled content from the compiled PHP file.

methods.name: loadCompiledTemplate
methods.description: Includes the compiled PHP template file, with workarounds for different PHP environments like HHVM and OPcache.
